story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify existing inbound date types from the 834 file
scenarios.descriptionRef:
Technical Notes
Data values are contained in the 834 transaction loops as follows:Assessment Date - Loop 2300, HD03
Effective Date - Loop 2000, DTP03
Maintenance Date - Loop 2000, DTP01
Adjust logic to selectively use Eligibility Date, Assessment Date, or Maintenance Date as transaction effective date based on the outlined business rules.
Ensure backward compatibility with existing EDI processing where applicable.
scenarios.acceptanceCriteriaRef: EDI is able to identify the following dates in the EDI 834 file (existing functionality): Effective Date, Assessment Date, Maintenance Date.
scenarios.dodRef:
All functionality detailed in the feature has been developed, implemented, and tested in Production.
Code is reviewed and meets coding standards.
Unit and integration tests have passed.
scenarios.description: Validate that inbound EDI 834 processing identifies Effective Date, Assessment Date, and Maintenance Date using the story-defined date logic so the downstream transaction effective date selection can occur without regressing existing functionality. Conditions to cover: 1) Effective Date is present and identified from the inbound 834 file. 2) Assessment Date is present and identified from the inbound 834 file. 3) Maintenance Date is present and identified from the inbound 834 file.

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility begins
scenarios.descriptionRef:
The business needs to utilize the Eligibility Date 2000 Loop (DTP*356/DTP*348) from the EDI 834 as the transaction effective date for all new enrollments, regardless of the Assessment Date. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date = 1/24/25, use Eligibility Date (1/31/25).
Examples / Scenarios
ScenarioEligibility Started?Transaction Effective DateNew enrollment (Future eligibility date) No Eligibility Date

scenarios.description: Validate that for a new enrollment whose eligibility span has not yet begun, the Eligibility Date is chosen as the transaction effective date regardless of the Assessment Date value and the Facets 'Eligibility Date' field refreshes to that winning date. Conditions to cover: 1) New enrollment file is processed while eligibility has not yet begun and Eligibility Date is later than Assessment Date. 2) Multiple Eligibility Date occurrences are present in the file and the first Eligibility Date occurrence is used as the transaction effective date.

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date when current eligibility has an assessment date change
scenarios.descriptionRef:
The business needs to utilize the Assessment Date as the transaction effective date for changes to current eligibility, if the Assessment Date has changed. For example: Eligibility Date = 1/31/25 and Assessment Date changes to 6/29/25, use Assessment Date (6/29/25).

Conditions to cover: 1) Assessment Number changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 2) Assessment Tier changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 3) Assessment Division changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 4) Aid Category changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 5) Rate Cell changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 6) Pregnancy Indicator changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 7) Assessment Number + Assessment Tier + Assessment Division change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 8) Aid Category + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 9) Pregnancy Indicator + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 10) Pregnancy Indicator + Aid Category + Rate Cell change while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun. 11) All relevant fields change together while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has not yet begun.

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date is unchanged and relevant field changes occur
scenarios.descriptionRef:
The business needs to utilize the Maintenance Date (DTP*303) as the transaction effective date for any changes to the items listed in Requirement 3 above, when the Assessment Date does NOT change, and those changes are received after the Eligibility Date.
Current State
Currently, Maintenance effective date is being used to split spans on Update files. This is causing mismatches with capitation calculations, and the Finance team is misreporting revenue.
Future State
The Maintenance Date will no longer be used to split spans based on Update (834) files, except as detailed in Requirement 4 above.

scenarios.title: Do not use Maintenance Date outside the specified rule path
scenarios.descriptionRef:
What is Changing
The Maintenance Date 2000 Loop (DTP*303) cannot be used for all change transactions. Depending on the change, and whether it is received prior to or after the initial Eligibility Date, the transaction effective date may reflect either the Assessment Date, Eligibility Date, or Maintenance Date.
Future State
The Maintenance Date will no longer be used to split spans based on Update (834) files, except as detailed in Requirement 4 above.

review.feedback: Coverage is broadly solid for the main rule paths, the Maintenance Date negative guardrail, UI effects, and an edge case for missing/invalid dates, but the set needs de-duplication and cleaner grounding. Collapse near-duplicates where the underlying validator is the same: TS_004 and TS_005 both test Assessment Date winning for current eligibility and differ only by the added unchanged-fields preservation check, and TS_002 and TS_009 both verify Facets reflects the chosen winning date. Also split over-collapsed fan-out: TS_006 and TS_007 each bundle many independent relevant-field change mechanisms plus grouped combinations and UI verification into one scenario, so separate the distinct mechanisms or reduce them to a truly parameterized form without merging extra validators. Fix terminology grounding errors against the authoritative hints/story: TS_001 uses bare element positions DTP03/DTP01 for date naming, and TS_007/TS_008 repeat the story text saying Maintenance Date is allowed 'except as detailed in Requirement 4 above' even though Requirement 5 is the Maintenance Date rule path. Keep the traceable references and main business-rule mapping, but tighten references and wording so each scenario points to the correct rule without contradiction.
gaps: TS_004 and TS_005 are under-collapsed: both cover current eligibility where Assessment Date changed and Assessment Date should win; they should be one parameterized scenario with the unchanged-relevant-fields preservation check included as an assertion.

TS_002 and TS_009 are under-collapsed: both validate that Facets reflects the selected winning date source; they should be merged rather than split into separate write-vs-UI winner checks unless the system interfaces are truly independent.

TS_006 is over-collapsed: it bundles many independent relevant-field change mechanisms (six single-field changes, four named groupings, all-fields change) plus '834 Spans Date Extension' UI verification under one scenario, and these can independently fail.
TS_007 is over-collapsed: it likewise merges many independent relevant-field change mechanisms plus UI verification into one scenario instead of isolating the distinct mechanisms.

Grounding/traceability issue: TS_001 contradicts the authoritative domain hints by naming dates with bare element positions ('Effective Date - Loop 2000, DTP03', 'Maintenance Date - Loop 2000, DTP01'), and TS_007/TS_008 repeat 'except as detailed in Requirement 4 above' even though the story's Maintenance Date rule is Requirement 5.
strengths: Main acceptance-criteria rule paths are represented, including new enrollment, current eligibility with Assessment Date change, future relevant-field changes, and current relevant-field changes.
Negative and edge coverage are present via TS_008 and TS_011 rather than only happy paths.
Several scenarios correctly incorporate story-specific details such as first-occurrence date handling and Facets UI field verification.
